## Summary
<!-- Use a Conventional Commit title, e.g. fix(words): preserve spelling.
Keep one coherent, small purpose; split unrelated changes into separate PRs. -->

## Linked saved issue
<!-- Link an existing issue. Use "Related to #…" for partial work; only use
closing keywords when all acceptance criteria are met. Do not invent issue IDs. -->

## Scope and non-goals

## Tests
<!-- Give exact commands and actual results. Explain anything not run;
distinguish local evidence from hosted checks. -->

## Security and privacy
<!-- Consider untrusted input, permissions, secrets, dependencies and data handling.
Do not include credentials or personal data in evidence. Explain N/A. -->

## UI and accessibility evidence
<!-- If relevant: screenshots, keyboard/mobile/accessibility checks with synthetic
data only. Otherwise say N/A. -->

## Risks and migrations
<!-- Include compatibility, migration/rollback needs, or "none". -->

## Review
- [ ] Self-review complete: focused diff, tests and security/privacy considered.
- [ ] Independent review complete (link review); otherwise outstanding before merge.
<!-- This checklist records review status; it does not enforce approval.
Title validation supports squash-commit conventions, not all commit history.
Required checks/reviews and squash-merge settings need administrator configuration. -->
